notes.recalls: Safety recalls, not sales or satisfaction. Appliance groups are matched from product names.
notes.energystar: Currently certified models only, a subset of the market; older years are understated.

recent.title: Dual Fuel Ranges Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire or Explosion Hazards; Manufactured by AGA Rangemaster
recent.hazard: Dual Fuel Ranges with a missing cap from the gas test port can cause a gas leak,​ posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire or explosion hazards.

recent.title: Galanz Americas Recalls Retro Refrigerators Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards; One Death Reported
recent.hazard: The recalled refrigerators' internal electrical components can short circuit and ignite, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire and burn hazards.

recent.title: Panasonic Recalls Electric Toaster Ovens Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
recent.hazard: The power cord insulation can be insufficient due to a protective fiberglass sleeve not covering it adequately, posing a risk of shock and/or fire hazard.

recent.title: Best Buy Recalls Insignia® Gas Ranges Due to Risk of Serious Injury from a Fire Hazard
recent.hazard: The recalled ranges' front-mounted knobs can be activated accidentally by humans or pets, posing a risk of serious injury from a fire hazard.

recent.title: Conair Recalls Cuisinart Propel+ Four Burner 3-In-1 Gas Grills Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Laceration Hazard
recent.hazard: The tempered glass window in the pizza oven can shatter during use, posing a risk of serious injury from laceration hazard.

recent.title: ZWILLING J. A. Henckels Aktiengesellschaft Recalls Electric Water Kettles Due to Risk of Serious Injury Due to Burn Hazard
recent.hazard: The kettle's handle can loosen and separate from the kettle, causing hot contents to spill, posing a risk of serious injury due to a burn hazard.

recent.title: Free-Standing Professional Gas Ranges Recalled Due to Risk of Burn Hazard; Manufactured by Fisher & Paykel
recent.hazard: The ovens in the ranges can experience a delayed ignition, causing gas to accumulate and the oven door to open from combustion, posing a burn hazard to users.

recent.title: Macy's Recalls Arch Studio Tea Kettles Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Burn Hazard
recent.hazard: The tea kettles' handle can detach during use when heated, posing a risk of serious injury from burn hazard.

recent.title: Electrolux Group Recalls Frigidaire Gas Ranges Due to Burn Hazard
recent.hazard: The ovens in the ranges can experience a delayed ignition of the oven's bake burner, posing a risk of burn hazards to users.

recent.title: Ozark Trail Tabletop 1-Burner Butane Camping Stoves Recalled Due to Serious Burn and Fire Hazards; Imported and Sold by Walmart; Manufactured by China Window Industry Co.
recent.hazard: The stoves can explode or catch fire, posing a burn and fire hazard to consumers.

recent.title: Tempo USA Recalls Ambiano Electric Pressure Cookers Due to Serious Burn Hazard, Multiple Burn Injuries Reported; Sold at ALDI
recent.hazard: The pressure-cooker lid can be opened before sufficient steam pressure has been released, causing hot contents to escape and posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers.

recent.title: Sunbeam Products Recalls More than One Million Oster French Door Countertop Ovens Due to Burn Hazard
recent.hazard: The oven's doors can unexpectedly close, posing a burn hazard to consumers.
